# `nlink-lab daemon`

<!-- generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit by hand -->

```text
Start the Zenoh backend daemon for a running lab

Usage: nlink-lab daemon [OPTIONS] <LAB>

Arguments:
  <LAB>
          Lab name (must be deployed)

Options:
  -i, --interval <INTERVAL>
          Metrics collection interval in seconds
          
          [default: 2]

      --zenoh-mode <ZENOH_MODE>
          Zenoh mode: peer or client
          
          [default: peer]

      --zenoh-listen <ZENOH_LISTEN>
          Zenoh listen endpoint

      --zenoh-connect <ZENOH_CONNECT>
          Zenoh connect endpoint

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
